resumeText:
Rohit Patil | Pune | rohit.patil@example.com

SUMMARY
Field sales team leader with 4 years in merchant payments sales for small shops.

EXPERIENCE
Team Leader - Offline Merchant QR, Sahyadri Pay Services, Pune (2024 - present)
- Lead a team of field sales executives covering 6 markets in east Pune.
- Managed a team of 8 and held one-to-one reviews with each executive every month.
- Do sales target planning each month and split the target across the team by market.
- Drive merchant onboarding for QR codes and soundbox deployment in kirana, pharmacy and hardware shops.
- Do territory planning for new markets with low coverage and assign beats.
- Track daily productivity of each executive in Excel and send the report to the area manager.
- Train new joiners on the pitch in Marathi and Hindi and use strong communication skills with shop owners.

Field Sales Executive, Sahyadri Pay Services, Pune (2022 - 2024)
- Did field sales visits to 25 shops a day to pitch QR codes and card machines.
- Did cross selling of merchant loans to active merchants.

SKILLS
Merchant acquisition, Soundbox sales, Excel, Marathi, Hindi, English

EDUCATION
BCom, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2021
